description: SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and data platforms — slow queries, deadlocks, replication, and connection pools.
name: Database & Data Platforms
quickFacts: Install Splunk DB Connect or vendor TA to collect database logs and performance metrics.

useCases.title: Slow Query Detection
useCases.value: Slow queries at the P95/P99 level directly impact checkout, search, and reporting latency, hitting revenue and SLA commitments. They also hold locks and inflate CPU/IO, degrading performance for othe…

useCases.title: Deadlock Monitoring
useCases.value: Deadlocks cause transaction failures and application errors. Rapid detection and root cause analysis minimizes impact.

useCases.title: Connection Pool Exhaustion
useCases.value: Exhausted connection pools cause application failures. Monitoring prevents outages and guides pool sizing decisions.

useCases.title: Replication Lag Monitoring
useCases.value: Replication lag affects data consistency and failover readiness. Monitoring ensures HA/DR objectives are met.

useCases.title: Tablespace / Data File Growth
useCases.value: Uncontrolled database growth leads to disk space exhaustion and outages. Trending enables proactive storage provisioning.

useCases.title: Backup Success Verification
useCases.value: Database backups are the last line of defense. Verifying success prevents discovering backup failures during a crisis.

useCases.title: Login Failure Monitoring
useCases.value: Repeated login failures may indicate brute-force attacks or misconfigured applications. Detection supports security posture.

useCases.title: Long-Running Transaction Detection
useCases.value: Long transactions hold locks, causing blocking chains that degrade application performance for many users.

useCases.title: Index Fragmentation
useCases.value: Highly fragmented indexes cause excessive I/O and slow query performance. Monitoring guides maintenance scheduling.

useCases.title: TempDB Contention (SQL Server)
useCases.value: TempDB contention is a common SQL Server bottleneck. Detection enables configuration tuning (multiple data files, trace flags).

useCases.title: Buffer Cache Hit Ratio
useCases.value: Low buffer cache hit ratio means excessive disk I/O. Monitoring guides memory allocation decisions.

useCases.title: Database Availability Group Health
useCases.value: AG/RAC cluster health is essential for HA. Detecting unhealthy replicas prevents unplanned failover failures.

useCases.title: Schema Change Detection
useCases.value: Unauthorized DDL changes to production databases can break applications. Detection ensures change control compliance.

useCases.title: Query Plan Regression
useCases.value: Query plan changes can cause sudden performance degradation. Detection enables rapid intervention (plan forcing, hint application).

useCases.title: Privilege Escalation Audit
useCases.value: Unauthorized privilege changes can enable data theft or sabotage. Audit trail is required for compliance.

useCases.title: Cluster Membership Changes
useCases.value: Node additions/removals affect data distribution and availability. Unexpected membership changes may indicate failures.

useCases.title: Replication Lag / Consistency
useCases.value: Replication lag causes stale reads and eventual consistency violations. Monitoring ensures data freshness SLAs are met.

useCases.title: Read/Write Latency Trending
useCases.value: Latency trending detects performance degradation before it impacts users. Enables proactive tuning and scaling decisions.

useCases.title: Shard Imbalance Detection
useCases.value: Uneven shard distribution causes hot spots and performance inconsistency. Rebalancing prevents overloaded nodes.

useCases.title: Compaction Monitoring
useCases.value: Pending compactions consume I/O and can cause write amplification. Monitoring ensures compaction keeps pace with writes.

useCases.title: GC Pause Detection
useCases.value: Long GC pauses in Java-based databases (Cassandra, Elasticsearch) cause request timeouts and can trigger node eviction from the cluster.

useCases.title: Connection Count Monitoring
useCases.value: Approaching connection limits causes client rejections. Monitoring enables proactive limit adjustment or connection pooling.

useCases.title: Index Build Monitoring
useCases.value: Index builds consume significant resources and can impact production performance. Tracking ensures builds complete within maintenance windows.

useCases.title: Memory Utilization
useCases.value: NoSQL databases are memory-intensive. Evictions indicate undersized cache, causing disk reads and performance degradation.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Cluster Health
useCases.value: Elasticsearch cluster status directly indicates data availability. Yellow/red status requires immediate attention to prevent data loss.

useCases.title: MongoDB Oplog Window
useCases.value: Oplog window shrinking indicates replication at risk of falling behind. Exhausted oplog causes replica set members to resync from scratch (full resync), causing extended downtime.

useCases.title: MongoDB WiredTiger Cache Pressure
useCases.value: Cache dirty/used ratio approaching eviction thresholds causes increased disk I/O and degraded query performance. Early detection enables cache sizing or workload tuning.

useCases.title: MongoDB Atlas Cluster Alerts
useCases.value: Atlas project alerts (CPU, connections, replication) forwarded to Splunk provide a single pane with on-prem MongoDB. Rapid correlation during incidents.

useCases.title: Cassandra Compaction Backlog and Throughput
useCases.value: Pending compactions and compaction throughput indicate whether the cluster keeps up with writes. Complements generic compaction UC with nodetool-derived rates.

useCases.title: Redis Memory Fragmentation (Cache Tier)
useCases.value: High `mem_fragmentation_ratio` on self-managed Redis (not only ElastiCache) wastes RAM and increases latency. Tracks non-cloud Redis clusters in the NoSQL section.

useCases.title: DynamoDB Throttling Events
useCases.value: Read/write throttle events mean application retries and latency spikes. Identifies hot partitions and undersized capacity modes.

useCases.title: CouchDB Replication Conflicts
useCases.value: Growing `_conflicts` document count indicates divergent replicas and data quality issues. Early detection prevents silent wrong reads.

useCases.title: MongoDB Oplog Window Sufficiency
useCases.value: Validates minimum oplog window hours against replica catch-up time under peak load. Extends oplog monitoring with capacity-style thresholds per deployment class.

useCases.title: Cassandra Tombstone Accumulation
useCases.value: High tombstone counts per read and GC pressure slow queries and repairs. Monitoring `TombstoneHistogram` and read repair backlog prevents timeouts.

useCases.title: Redis Eviction Rate
useCases.value: Rising `evicted_keys` per second indicates memory pressure and cache miss storms. Distinct from fragmentation and hit ratio for ops response.

useCases.title: HBase RegionServer Failover Events
useCases.value: RegionServer death and region reassignment cause latency spikes and possible unavailability. Log and metric correlation speeds recovery.

useCases.title: CouchDB View Build Times
useCases.value: Long-running view index builds block compaction and increase disk I/O. Tracks `_active_tasks` indexer progress and failures.

useCases.title: MongoDB Index Inefficiency (Usage vs Size)
useCases.value: Indexes with near-zero `accesses.ops` and large `size` waste RAM and slow writes. Identifies candidates for drop or partial indexes.

useCases.title: RDS/Aurora Performance Insights
useCases.value: Performance Insights identifies top SQL and wait events without agent installation. Enables rapid diagnosis of managed database bottlenecks.

useCases.title: Automated Failover Events
useCases.value: Managed database failovers cause brief outages. Detection enables impact analysis and root cause investigation.

useCases.title: Read Replica Lag
useCases.value: Replica lag affects read consistency for applications using read replicas. Monitoring prevents stale data serving.

useCases.title: Storage Auto-Scaling Events
useCases.value: Tracks storage auto-scaling events for cost awareness and identifies databases with rapid growth needing attention.

useCases.title: Maintenance Window Tracking
useCases.value: Awareness of upcoming and completed maintenance ensures teams are prepared for potential service impact.

useCases.title: Redis Memory Fragmentation Ratio
useCases.value: Fragmentation ratio > 1.5 indicating memory inefficiency. High fragmentation wastes RAM and can trigger OOM or evictions under memory pressure.

useCases.title: Redis Keyspace Hit / Miss Ratio
useCases.value: Cache effectiveness trending. Low hit ratio indicates cache is not serving requests effectively, increasing load on backing stores.

useCases.title: Aurora Serverless Scaling Events
useCases.value: ACU (capacity unit) scale-up/down events explain latency and cost. Tracks whether scaling policy matches workload bursts.

useCases.title: Azure Cosmos DB RU Consumption
useCases.value: Normalized RU/s consumption vs provisioned throughput identifies hot partitions and autoscale effectiveness.

useCases.title: Cloud Spanner Instance Health
useCases.value: CPU utilization, hot spots, and replication delay for Spanner nodes indicate risk of write/read stalls on globally distributed data.

useCases.title: Managed Database Failover Events (Multi-Cloud)
useCases.value: Single search across RDS failover, Azure SQL failover, and Cloud SQL failover for hybrid teams. Supplements UC-7.3.2 with normalized fields.

useCases.title: Azure SQL Database DTU Exhaustion
useCases.value: DTU/vCore saturation causes throttling and query timeouts. Distinct from generic RDS CPU for Azure-only deployments.

useCases.title: Cloud SQL Storage Auto-Grow Events
useCases.value: Automatic storage increases for GCP Cloud SQL (and similar) signal rapid data growth and cost impact.

useCases.title: Managed Backup Retention Compliance
useCases.value: Verifies automated backup snapshots exist within required retention for RDS, Azure SQL LTR, and Cloud SQL backups.

useCases.title: Read Replica Lag Trending (Percentiles)
useCases.value: p95/p99 replica lag exposes tail behavior missed by max-only dashboards. Applies to RDS, Aurora, and Azure read replicas.

useCases.title: Azure SQL Managed Instance Resource Utilization
useCases.value: SQL Managed Instance provides near-100% SQL Server compatibility in Azure. CPU, storage I/O, and memory pressure against provisioned limits directly impact query performance and can cause throttling.

useCases.title: Azure SQL Managed Instance Failover Group Status
useCases.value: Failover groups provide geo-redundancy for SQL Managed Instance. Monitoring replication lag and failover events ensures disaster recovery readiness and detects unplanned failovers.

useCases.title: Open Cursor Leak Detection
useCases.value: Open cursors that are never closed accumulate in the database session context and eventually exhaust the cursor limit (Oracle ORA-01000, SQL Server max open cursors), causing application errors and f…

useCases.title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion
useCases.value: When the application connection pool or database max_connections is exhausted, new requests fail with connection errors. Detecting high connection count and pool saturation prevents outages.

useCases.title: Long-Running Query and Blocking Session Detection
useCases.value: Queries that run for hours or sessions that block others cause timeouts and user impact. Identifying blocking chains and long-running queries supports tuning and kill decisions.

useCases.title: Table and Index Bloat and Maintenance Window
useCases.value: Table and index bloat (PostgreSQL) or fragmentation (SQL Server) degrades query performance and wastes space. Tracking bloat and last vacuum/rebuild supports maintenance scheduling.

useCases.title: Database Backup and Archive Log Retention Verification
useCases.value: Failed or missing backups and unarchived redo logs risk data loss and prevent point-in-time recovery. Verifying backup success and archive log retention ensures RPO is met.

useCases.title: Database User and Privilege Change Audit
useCases.value: New users, role grants, or privilege changes can indicate compromise or policy violation. Auditing supports compliance (SOX, PCI) and security investigations.

useCases.title: PostgreSQL WAL Growth
useCases.value: WAL accumulation indicating replication issues or archival failures. Uncontrolled WAL growth exhausts disk space and can halt the database.

useCases.title: PostgreSQL Vacuum Activity
useCases.value: Autovacuum running, dead tuples, and table bloat affect query performance. Monitoring ensures vacuum keeps pace with write workload and prevents bloat.

useCases.title: PostgreSQL Connection Pool Monitoring (PgBouncer)
useCases.value: Pool utilization and wait queue length indicate connection pressure. High utilization or growing wait queue causes application timeouts.

useCases.title: MySQL / MariaDB InnoDB Buffer Pool Hit Ratio
useCases.value: Buffer pool effectiveness; low hit ratio means excessive disk I/O and degraded query performance.

useCases.title: MySQL Binary Log Space Usage
useCases.value: Binlog accumulation on disk can exhaust disk space and impact replication. Monitoring enables proactive purging or archival.

useCases.title: Oracle Tablespace Utilization
useCases.value: Approaching max size per tablespace causes ORA-1653 (out of space) errors and application failures. Proactive monitoring prevents outages.

useCases.title: PostgreSQL Replication Lag (Streaming)
useCases.value: `pg_stat_replication` write/flush/replay lag bytes and seconds catch standby drift before read-your-writes violations. Complements generic replication UC with PostgreSQL-native metrics.

useCases.title: MySQL InnoDB Buffer Pool Hit Ratio Monitoring
useCases.value: Fleet-wide buffer pool hit ratio SLO for MySQL/MariaDB with per-instance drilldown. Aligns capacity reviews with read IO pressure.

useCases.title: Oracle Tablespace Growth Trending
useCases.value: Week-over-week growth rate per tablespace drives forecast and ASM/space procurement. Extends point-in-time utilization with trend.

useCases.title: SQL Server Always On AG Health and Replica Sync
useCases.value: Combined view of `synchronization_health`, redo queue, and log send queue sizes for AG replicas. Operationalizes UC-7.1.12 with queue depth.

useCases.title: Database Backup Chain Validation
useCases.value: Verifies full→diff→log chain continuity (SQL Server LSN chain, Oracle archivelog sequence) to detect missing backups before restore drills fail.

useCases.title: Long-Running Query Detection (Active Sessions)
useCases.value: Surfaces currently running queries exceeding elapsed threshold with SQL hash and wait type—faster triage than transaction-only UC-7.1.8.

useCases.title: Deadlock Frequency by Database
useCases.value: Counts deadlocks per hour/database to detect code regressions after releases. Complements UC-7.1.2 event search with KPIs.

useCases.title: Connection Pool Exhaustion (Application vs Database Limit)
useCases.value: Joins app pool `activeThreads`/`waiting` with DB `session_count` to distinguish app-side pool starvation from DB `max_connections` hits.

useCases.title: Index Fragmentation Maintenance Priority
useCases.value: Ranks indexes by fragmentation × page_count to schedule rebuilds during maintenance windows. Extends UC-7.1.9 with prioritization score.

useCases.title: Temp Tablespace Usage (Oracle TEMP)
useCases.value: High `TEMP` usage for sorts and hashes causes ORA-1652. Tracks session temp consumption vs temp tablespace limits.

useCases.title: Query Plan Regression (Runtime vs Baseline)
useCases.value: Compares current average CPU/duration from Query Store or AWR to baselines by `query_id`/`plan_hash`. Tightens UC-7.1.14 with explicit baseline lookup.

useCases.title: Database Patch Compliance
useCases.value: Compares instance `@@VERSION` / `banner` / Oracle `DBA_REGISTRY_HISTORY` to approved patch levels per environment. Supports security patching SLAs.

useCases.title: Database Audit Log Tampering Detection
useCases.value: Detects unexpected audit trail disable, audit file deletion, or Unified Audit policy changes that may indicate cover-up activity.

useCases.title: Query Performance Trending
useCases.value: Identifies expensive and slow queries impacting warehouse performance and cost. Enables query optimization and cost reduction.

useCases.title: Cluster Scaling Events
useCases.value: Tracks auto-scaling decisions for cost optimization. Identifies whether current scaling policies match workload patterns.

useCases.title: Data Pipeline Health
useCases.value: Failed or delayed ETL/ELT pipelines cause stale data for reporting and analytics. Early detection prevents downstream impact.

useCases.title: Credit / Cost per Query
useCases.value: Directly ties compute cost to individual queries, enabling chargeback and cost optimization. Identifies runaway queries consuming excessive resources.

useCases.title: Warehouse Utilization
useCases.value: Right-sizing warehouses reduces cost while maintaining performance. Utilization data drives scaling policy decisions.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Cluster Health and Shard Status
useCases.value: Red/yellow cluster, unassigned shards, and JVM pressure indicate data availability risk. Early detection prevents data loss and service degradation.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Index Size and Document Count Trending
useCases.value: Growth forecasting for indices enables proactive storage provisioning and index lifecycle management (ILM) tuning.

useCases.title: ClickHouse Query Performance
useCases.value: Merge operations, insert rate, and query duration indicate system health. Monitoring enables tuning and capacity planning for analytical workloads.

useCases.title: Snowflake Warehouse Credit Usage
useCases.value: Credits consumed per warehouse and role drive chargeback and right-sizing. Spikes indicate runaway queries or undersized warehouses thrashing.

useCases.title: Databricks Cluster Utilization
useCases.value: Cluster DBU hours, worker counts, and idle time reveal over-provisioned pools and jobs that keep clusters alive unnecessarily.

useCases.title: Redshift Query Queue Depth
useCases.value: WLM queue length and max execution time show concurrency saturation. Growing queue depth precedes disk-based spills and timeouts.

useCases.title: BigQuery Cost Anomalies
useCases.value: Sudden jumps in bytes billed or slot usage often trace to one bad query or new scheduled job. Statistical alerting limits surprise invoices.

useCases.title: Snowflake Query Spillage (Bytes Spilled to Local/Remote Storage)
useCases.value: Spillage indicates insufficient warehouse size or poorly written queries (exploding joins). Drives warehouse tier and query tuning decisions.

useCases.title: Databricks Job Failure Rate
useCases.value: Failed notebook/jar jobs block downstream analytics. Failure rate by job name prioritizes fixes for critical pipelines.

useCases.title: Azure Synapse Analytics SQL Pool Performance
useCases.value: Synapse dedicated SQL pools have DWU-based resource limits. Queries competing for resources cause queueing, and tempdb contention degrades batch processing. Monitoring ensures analytics workloads mee…

useCases.title: Azure Synapse Pipeline Execution Health
useCases.value: Synapse pipelines orchestrate data movement and transformation. Failed pipeline runs cause stale analytics data, broken reports, and missed business deadlines.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Cluster Health (Red / Yellow)
useCases.value: Yellow or red cluster status means primary/replica shards are not fully allocated; search and indexing can fail or degrade. Catching status changes early limits user impact.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Shard Allocation Failures
useCases.value: Unassigned or stuck relocating shards leave data unavailable or at risk; allocation explain output points to disk, routing, or settings issues before outages spread.

useCases.title: OpenSearch Index Performance
useCases.value: Slow merges, refresh intervals, and segment counts drive query latency and heap use; tracking per-index stats keeps search SLAs achievable.

useCases.title: OpenSearch Search Latency
useCases.value: P95/P99 query latency directly affects application UX; separating queue time from query time narrows tuning to thread pools vs. mappings and shards.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Indexing Rate Monitoring
useCases.value: A sudden drop in docs/s indexed can signal pipeline failures, bulk rejections, or cluster overload; sustained spikes may require scaling or throttling.

useCases.title: Solr Query Cache Hit Ratio
useCases.value: Low filter/query cache hit rates increase CPU and latency; tuning caches and queries improves headroom without adding nodes.

useCases.title: Solr Replication Lag
useCases.value: Followers lagging behind leaders serve stale results and extend recovery time; catching replication gaps protects read consistency and failover readiness.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Disk Watermark Alerts
useCases.value: Elasticsearch blocks shard allocation when flood-stage watermarks are hit; proactive disk alerts prevent read-only indices and cluster yellow/red states.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch JVM Heap Pressure
useCases.value: High heap usage and frequent GC pause search and indexing and can trigger circuit breakers; JVM trends predict node instability before restarts.

useCases.title: OpenSearch Snapshot / Backup Status
useCases.value: Failed or missing snapshots break restore and compliance RPO; monitoring repository and snapshot completion protects against silent backup gaps.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Circuit Breaker Trips
useCases.value: Circuit breaker exceptions stop requests to protect the cluster; repeated trips indicate oversized aggregations, mapping issues, or undersized heap.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Thread Pool Rejections
useCases.value: Thread pool rejections (HTTP 429) mean the cluster cannot keep up with search or indexing load. Sustained rejections cause data loss on ingest and timeouts on search.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Search Latency and Slow Queries
useCases.value: Search latency trending detects degradation before users notice. Slow log analysis identifies expensive queries for optimization.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch ILM Policy Failures
useCases.value: Failed ILM transitions leave indices in the wrong lifecycle phase — hot data stays on expensive storage, old data never deletes, rollover stops creating new indices. Silent failures accumulate until…

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Snapshot Failures
useCases.value: Failed snapshots mean no viable backup for disaster recovery. Partial snapshots may leave indices unrecoverable. Monitoring ensures RPO commitments are met.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Cross-Cluster Replication Lag
useCases.value: CCR follower lag directly impacts disaster recovery readiness. Excessive lag means a failover would lose recent data. Monitoring ensures replication SLAs are met.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Pending Cluster Tasks
useCases.value: A growing backlog of pending cluster tasks indicates the master node cannot process cluster state updates fast enough. This delays shard allocation, mapping updates, and index creation.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Fielddata and Cache Evictions
useCases.value: Fielddata evictions force expensive re-computation of in-memory data structures, causing search latency spikes. Query cache evictions reduce the benefit of repeated queries. Tracking eviction rates g…

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Segment Merge Pressure
useCases.value: Heavy segment merge activity competes with search for disk I/O, causing latency spikes. Merge throttling slows indexing. Monitoring merge pressure helps balance indexing throughput against search per…

useCases.title: Solr Core Admin Health
useCases.value: Core-level errors (recovery failures, corrupt index flags, leader election issues) degrade search for specific collections; admin health checks catch per-core problems early.

useCases.title: Elasticsearch Ingest Pipeline Error Rate
useCases.value: Ingest pipeline failures silently drop or corrupt documents before indexing. Monitoring error rates per pipeline ensures data quality and completeness.

useCases.title: Database Connection Pool Utilization Trending
useCases.value: Peak connection pool utilization over 30 days shows how close applications are to exhausting database sessions. Rising peaks justify pool tuning, connection string fixes, or server scale-up before lo…

useCases.title: Slow Query Volume Trending
useCases.value: Counting queries exceeding a duration threshold per day quantifies database pain for developers and DBAs. Upward trends after releases often indicate missing indexes or plan regressions before p95 la…

useCases.title: Replication Lag Trending
useCases.value: Maximum and average replication lag by replica over 30 days validates disaster-recovery readiness and read-consistency expectations. Gradual lag growth can signal network, disk, or write-volume probl…

useCases.title: Database Backup Size Trending
useCases.value: Monthly backup size growth forecasts storage for backup appliances and cloud object storage costs. Anomalous jumps can indicate bulk data loads, failed truncations, or ransomware preparation worth in…

useCases.value: Average fragmentation percentage over 30 days guides `REBUILD`/`REORG` scheduling and fill-factor reviews. Slow upward trends on hot tables correlate with extra I/O and slower queries even when CPU l…
